title.narrative: UNICEF continues to strengthen access to WASH services with a focus on climate resilience, supported by private sector partnerships and other actors. Significant progress has been achieved in menstrual hygiene management, disability inclusion and enhancing WASH services along migration routes, and in emergencies caused by climate-related events, benefiting vulnerable populations.
